description.message: Lets your local maxedcode agent read and use your tabs, and chat with it in a side panel. Nothing is sent anywhere else.

working.message: maxedcode is working in this tab

notConnectedSub.message: Turn the browser on in maxedcode: Settings → maxedcode → Browser.

offBanner.message: maxedcode cannot see or use this browser now.

allow.message: Allow maxedcode to use this browser

allowSub.message: The agent reads pages and clicks or types in them when a task needs it. In Ask mode it asks first.

emptyHead.message: Ask about this page or what to do in the browser

emptySub.message: Your local maxedcode does it: it reads the page, clicks and types. Chats are also in the maxedcode app.

placeholder.message: Ask about or act on this page…

bigChat.message: The chat is {pct}% full: a new chat answers faster.

noticeCut.message: The reply hit the length limit; the agent continues it

noticeEmpty.message: The model returned an empty reply; asking again

noticeLoop.message: The agent repeated itself; the repeats were removed from the context

whyWrite.message: changes a file in the project

whyBrowser.message: works in your own browser, where you are logged in: it can open pages, click and type

whyMcp.message: calls an external MCP tool, which can do things outside this project
